story_text: As a user, I want the system to reject a task title longer than 200 characters so that titles remain readable.

positive.title: Create task with exactly 200-character title (upper boundary — valid)
steps: 1. Generate a task title that is exactly 200 characters long.
2. Attempt to create a task using this title.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · full title stored without truncation

positive.title: Create task with 199-character title (boundary − 1)
steps: 1. Generate a task title that is 199 characters long.
2. Attempt to create a task using this title.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · full title stored without truncation

negative.title: Create task with 201-character title (boundary + 1 — invalid)
steps: 1. Generate a task title that is 201 characters long.
2. Attempt to create a task using this title.

negative.title: Create task with 1-character title (lower boundary — valid)
steps: 1. Generate a task title that is 1 character long.
2. Attempt to create a task using this title.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states 5 character minimum

negative.title: Update existing task title to 201 characters (boundary + 1 — invalid)
steps: 1. Create a task with a valid title.
2. Generate a new title that is 201 characters long.
3. Attempt to update the existing task's title to this new title.

edge.title: Create task with 500-character title (far above max)
steps: 1. Generate a task title that is 500 characters long.
2. Attempt to create a task using this title.
